title: an expired cookie (401) is not auto-judged: a correct manual command instead
titleZh: cookie 过期(401)不做自动判定:给出可用的手工命令
why: The collector makes no HTTP request at all by design (curl under schannel returns 000 even against a healthy server, and a naive request could not tell 401 from 403 anyway). Reporting a 401/403/200 verdict would therefore be fiction. What must exist instead: an explicit unknown, a manualReview flag, and one copy-pasteable Node command that distinguishes the cases. The absence of any HTTP call is the security property being kept.
inject: a client-role run with a peer: the collector is expected to declare the HTTPS judgement as out of scope, not to fabricate one
expectSummary: HTTPS_CLIENT_ONLY unknown/https_client_only, manualReview=true, manual Node command present
